releases.title: Private semantic workbench
capabilities: Allowlisted Tailnet users can talk with one isolated deterministic Clanker-LM runtime per browser session.
Every answer keeps six evidence fields visible: Answer, Truth, Source, Certainty, Memory, and VADUG.
The browser can export an inspectable snapshot or reset its ephemeral session memory.
limitations: This is a bounded research-alpha workbench, not a claim of unrestricted conversation.
Session memory is ephemeral; a service restart clears state that was not exported.
The service is private and Tailnet-only. It has no Funnel or public route.

deployment.label: Live · private Tailnet
deployment.detail: Reviewed PR #106 is the deployed baseline. No later roadmap milestone is claimed as shipped.
